name: Onikiri-den
source:
Thousands years ago a great demon was defeated. That demon appears again in modern time. Momotaro's reincarnation Momota set off to defeat the evil again. 
An adventure quiz game with a story featuring familiar characters from old japanese tales. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
数千年前，一只强大的恶鬼曾被人击败。如今，它再度现身于现代社会。桃太郎的转世桃太为再次消灭邪恶，踏上了征途。

这是一款冒险问答游戏，故事中会有许多日本古老传说里的熟悉角色登场。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
